# The DevTools sync adds disabled feature defaults and a service-worker sidebar choice

The application preference file adds ten explicit defaults. The jstracer button and eight other Boolean features default false; the Application sidebar defaults to service-workers. The build registers this file as preprocessed application preferences. This is a scoped default configuration change, not an exhaustive upstream sync or a runtime opening guarantee.

Scope: Thunderbird application DevTools preference defaults.
